title: AUTH-093 logout blocks renewal paths

assertionSteps.title: 1. Given User A is authenticated as user-a in an isolated browser context

steps.title: Install clock "Tue Jan 01 2030 07:59:00 GMT+0800 (Singapore Standard Time)"
One visible workspace tab must have the exact name "WS-A".
One visible workspace tab must have the exact name "WS-A".
Pause clock "Tue Jan 01 2030 08:00:00 GMT+0800 (Singapore Standard Time)"

assertionSteps.title: 2. And the selected fixture tab is labelled "WS-A" inside the tablist named "workspaces" on the Home page
3. And access A is expired; refresh R expires at controlled time T+600 seconds
4. And the dialog named "Your session has been expired" on the Home page is visible
5. And User A already clicked Logout; the 1000-millisecond logout delay is pending
6. When the browser changes this page from visible to hidden
7. And the pending mouse-activity timer fires
8. Then the button labelled "Extend" inside the dialog named "Your session has been expired" is disabled
9. And the browser records exactly 0 new POST requests to "/api/auth/v2/sso/refreshtoken"
10. And the browser records exactly 0 new POST requests to "/api/auth/v2/sso/extend"
11. And the browser records exactly 0 new POST requests to "/api/auth/v2/sso/relogin"
12. When the controlled browser clock advances through the 1000-millisecond logout delay
13. Then the textbox with placeholder "Enter Username" on the login page is visible
14. And the text input with placeholder "Enter Password" on the login page is visible
15. And the button labelled "Sign In" on the login page is visible
16. And the tablist named "workspaces" on the Home page is absent

annotations.description: Actual MFE with controlled HTTP responses, clock, visibility and popup boundary. Browser-only unsigned credentials. No real provider or server security acceptance.

limits: The recorded assertions and environment binding limit the supported business result.
